text: Across the world, the berserkers roam - warriors bound by a single, relentless pursuit. Strength is their currency, battle their forge.
zh: 狂战士的足迹遍布世界各地——他们是被同一种执念驱使的战士。力量是他们的通货，战斗是他们的熔炉。

text: Scattered across lands, far away from their once homes and families in Vicluth, they test themselves against the wild, against men, against the limits of their own endurance.
zh: 他们散落四方，远离维克卢斯的故土与亲族，以荒野为敌，以世人为敌，向自身耐力的极限发起考验。

text: Their ultimate goal is no simple victory. To prove their worth, they must slay a beast mighty enough to earn the respect of their elders.
zh: 他们的终极目标绝非寻常的胜利。为了证明自身的价值，他们必须斩杀一头足够强大的巨兽，以赢得长老们的敬重。

text: Until then, they wander, seeking challenges, honing their bodies and minds, growing stronger with every scar.
zh: 在那之前，他们四处流浪，寻求挑战，磨砺身心，每添一道伤疤便更强一分。

text: Some never return, while others walk into the halls of their ancestors, bearing the mark of conquest - proof that they have found their strength in the heart of a worthy foe.
zh: 有些人一去不返；另一些人则带着征服的印记步入先祖的殿堂——那是他们在强敌心脏中觅得力量的明证。
